import sys,json,pathlib,numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1])
import ds_data02_stage2_f2_replay_v11 as m
request=json.loads(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text())

v=np.ones(11,dtype=bool);v[[2,5,8]]=False
f=m.flux(t,d,v,np.full(11,2.),initial_mass=2.)
assert f['net_flux_mass_kg']==6. and f['unknown_flux_net_bound_kg']==2.
assert abs(f['net_flux_mass_kg']-0.)>f['unknown_flux_net_bound_kg']
a=m.flux(np.array([0.,1.,2.]),np.array([np.nan]*3),np.zeros(3,dtype=bool),np.array([np.nan]*3),initial_mass=2.)

p=request['observer_profile']; frames=p['query_frame_indices']; n=len(frames);quants=p['mass_quantiles'];den=request['initial_mass_denominator']['denominator_kg']
source={'current_catalog_sha256':p['current_binding_sha256'],'trajectory_h5_producer_sha256':p['trajectory_producer_sha256'],'source_files':p['source_file_sha256'],'binding_status':'MANUFACTURED_OPERATOR_COUNTEREXAMPLE'}
result={'schema':m.RESULT_SCHEMA,'source_binding':source,'initial_mass_denominator':{'denominator_kg':den},'frame_observations':[{'frame':f,'mass_weighted_com_m':[0.,0.,0.],'mass_weighted_mean_velocity_m_s':[0.,0.,0.],'mass_weighted_kinetic_energy_J':1.,'mass_quantile_front_m':{str(q):0. for q in quants},'mass_distribution_kg':[den,0.,0.,0.]} for f in frames],'labels':[{'status':'observed','event_time_s':1.}]}
pred={'source_binding':source,'observer_profile_sha256':p['sha256'],'query_times_s':p['query_times_s'],'mass_weighted_com_m':np.zeros((n,3)).tolist(),'mass_weighted_mean_velocity_m_s':np.full((n,3),1000.).tolist(),'mass_weighted_kinetic_energy_J':np.full(n,1.e9).tolist(),'mass_quantile_front_m':np.full((n,len(quants)),1.e9).tolist(),'mass_distribution_fraction':np.tile([1.,0.,0.,0.],(n,1)).tolist(),'event_status':['observed'],'event_time_s':[1.],'evaluation_seconds':0.,'output_bytes':0}
e=m.evaluate_manual_predictions(result,pred,p)
assert e['status']=='PASS' and e['metrics']['velocity_absolute_max_error_m_s']==1000.
assert e['metrics']['kinetic_energy_relative_max_error']>1.e8 and e['metrics']['mass_front_relative_max_error']>1.e8
out={'schema':'ds02.stage2.v11-independent-counterexamples.v1','status':'EXPECTED_DEFECTS_REPRODUCED','trajectory_hdf5_read':False,'model_invoked':False,'multiple_disjoint_missing_intervals':{'v11_reported_observed_net_kg':f['net_flux_mass_kg'],'v11_reported_unknown_net_bound_kg':f['unknown_flux_net_bound_kg'],'endpoint_membership_true_net_kg':0.,'bound_contains_true_net':False},'all_mass_nan_with_frozen_initial_mass':{'initial_mass_kg':2.,'v11_reported_unknown_net_bound_kg':a['unknown_flux_net_bound_kg'],'unknown_endpoint_bound_can_be_zero':False},'wrong_velocity_KE_front_predictions':e,'gross_recross_counterexample':'An unknown saved bracket can contain arbitrarily many back-and-forth crossings; one frozen mass cannot bound gross crossing mass without additional trajectory regularity evidence.','scientific_qualification':'NONE; operator counterexamples only'}
path=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[3]);path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
with path.open('x') as h:json.dump(out,h,indent=2);h.write('\n')
print('EXPECTED_DEFECTS_REPRODUCED: three independent v11 operator counterexamples')
